name: Eat the Rich
source:
A short game about society and love. 

You wake up in a strange restaurant crawling with stranger creatures, and a man who claims to be your boyfriend, stating you’re on a date with him. Talk with your boyfriend and other customers in the restaurant, and maybe you can wake up from this strange situation. 

[From [url=https://apleen.itch.io/eat-the-rich]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部探讨社会与爱情的短篇游戏。

你在一家诡异的餐厅里醒来，四周爬满了更加古怪的生物，眼前还有一名自称是你男友的男子，声称你们正在约会。与你的“男友”及餐厅里的其他食客交谈吧，或许你能借此从这场离奇的处境中清醒过来。

[摘自[url=https://apleen.itch.io/eat-the-rich]itch.io[/url]]
